lead: A `bun nv verify` re-run after a red one can report the conformance tree green without running the case you just added.
body: The red run records the tree, and the re-run selects only from the paths changed since then, so a new `.nvst` stays unrun under the old count. Run a new case yourself with `target/covws/<host triple>/debug/nvs.exe test <case>`, never `target/debug/nvs.exe`, which can be hours stale. The selection is `tools/nv/cmd/verify.ts`'s `since the recorded tree` line.
